title: Fixture Contract

purpose.plainLanguage: A compact valid instance that exercises every required contract group.
populations: Schema authors who review the contract boundary.
jobs: Establish acceptance of the minimum complete instance.

fits: Focused schema validation during contract authoring.
poorFits: A production visual language needs its complete maintained guidance.
fit.smallestUsefulDose: One complete instance exercises the required contract groups.

invariants: Every required group remains present and structurally valid.
permittedVariation: Prose and repository paths can vary within their declared bounds.

families: System sans carries body text and controls.
uses: Body text and metadata retain distinct roles.

geometry.depth: Solid borders carry the compact fixture depth.
geometry.spacing: A regular spacing scale separates each contract group.

errorRecovery: Accepted work stays visible while retry runs.
behavior.focus: A visible focus ring identifies the active control.
behavior.keyboard: Native controls preserve their keyboard behavior.
behavior.motion: State changes remain clear with motion enabled or reduced.
behavior.noJavaScript: The base document preserves the useful reading.

media.reflow320CssPx: Content follows source order at 320 CSS pixels.
media.textResize200Percent: Containers grow with text at 200 percent resize.
media.print: Print retains state labels and evidence boundaries.
media.forcedColors: System colors carry text, borders, focus, and selection.
media.reducedMotion: The final state appears directly when motion is reduced.
media.svg: Informative SVGs receive a title, description, and semantic companion.
media.imagery: Informative images receive alternatives, captions, and source standing.

establishes: Schema validation establishes structural acceptance for this fixture.
boundaries: Material design quality receives its own implementation review.
reentry: A schema change reopens fixture validation.
